metadata.description: Agent skills that check work before it leaves your hands: a website before it deploys, a draft before it is sent, a post before it is published.

plugins.name: before-it-ships
plugins.description: Three skills: website-review-build (audit and build sites so every rule is a check that can fail), second-draft (trace every number in a draft to its source before it is sent) and company-post-scoring (a gate and 16-point rubric for company page posts).
